subject: Terms ladder + procurement portal brokerage for renewal
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Park <lisa.park@novamed.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Terms ladder + procurement portal brokerage for renewal

Hi Lisa —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. NovaMed’s usage is trending ahead of the plan and the renewal is up in early December. Before we prep a formal amendment, two asks from procurement we want to align on so we can keep the renewal timeline tight:

1) Procurement portal onboarding: you mentioned a preferred PO workflow via your procurement portal (PO-ops). We need the portal SSO details and the exact PO threshold for auto-approve lanes (you flagged $50k vs $150k earlier).
2) Terms ladder: NovaMed is interested in a tiered-term/commit ladder (12 mo base, optional quarterly top-ups tied to capacity buckets). We want to propose explicit ramp triggers and a fallback pricing band if usage moves into burst capacity.

Attached is a one-page recap of current usage and a proposed term ladder so legal and procurement can see concrete numbers. Can you confirm the portal contact and whether your team requires the SOC2 attestation file uploaded into the portal or emailed to procurement?

If it helps, Jordan will coordinate the portal SSO setup and Marissa will scope a short amendment draft. Proposed next step: portal connect + brief sync with PO-ops this week so we can route the PO lane before the renewal kickoff.

Best,
Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0138

Attachments: Redwood_Renewal_Summary_Q3226.pdf (summary), SOC2-attenuation-statement.txt (attestation note)
From: Lisa Park <lisa.park@novamed.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: PO-ops <po-ops@novamed.com>
Date: 2026-10-29T12:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Terms ladder + procurement portal brokerage for renewal

Ben —

Thanks for the recap and the attachments. Quick answers:

- Portal contact is PO-ops (copied). The portal accepts SAML SSO; we need metadata XML and a contact for the integration engineer.
- Threshold: anything <= $75,000 can be auto-approved via the portal; anything above gets routed to legal for PO re-review.
- SOC2: procurement policy requires the attestation to be uploaded to the portal (preferred) and a copy emailed to procurement for the certificate vault.

PO-ops — can you confirm the steps and available windows for an SSO test this week? We have a maintenance window Thursday 14:00–16:00 ET if that helps.

Lisa Park
Director, Procurement Operations, NovaMed
lisa.park@novamed.com

On Thu, Oct 29, 2026 at 09:12 AM Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai> wrote:

Hi all —

Thursday 14:00 ET works for an SSO smoke test. For SAML we need: 1) SP metadata XML, 2) Assertion Consumer Service URL, 3) an integration contact (phone + email). Please send as a secure upload or to our secure intake link.

Also: the portal supports a ‘contract ladder’ field for multi-commit agreements (we’ll store tier triggers but the PO needs explicit dollars per tier). If you plan to use quarterly top-ups, the PO should list the base and max annual cap to avoid rework.

Thanks — PO-ops
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: PO-ops <po-ops@novamed.com>, Lisa Park <lisa.park@novamed.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-29T16:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Terms ladder + procurement portal brokerage for renewal

Thanks — Jordan from Redwood on integration.

Ben and I have the SP metadata and the ACS endpoints ready. I’ll upload the metadata XML to your secure intake link and be on the call Thursday to walk through assertion checks.

A couple of operational notes so procurement has what it needs:
- We will include a single PO template that captures the ladder: Base (12 mo) = $120k/year, Quarterly top-ups = up to $40k per quarter, annual cap = $280k.
- Fallback pricing band if burst capacity is used: we propose an overage rate + automatic fallback to a compatible model variant to maintain latency SLAs.

Marissa — can you start a short amendment draft that lists these dollar bands and an escalation step (email to procurement + 72-hour dispute window) so PO-ops has legal language?

-Jordan

Draft amendment attached (one page) that maps the ladder numbers Jordan mentioned into clause text and includes the escalation path. Key callouts:
- Definition block for ‘Quarterly Top-Up’ and ‘Burst Capacity’.
- PO must state Base dollar and Annual Cap to avoid ambiguity in the portal.
- Attachment list for procurement: SOC2 attestation, current SLA, and a short runbook for SSO tests.

If the wording looks good to you I’ll circulate the final to Legal. If procurement wants different wording for the 72-hour dispute window, indicate that in-line and I’ll update.

Lisa
